description: ADR-150 — static security scan of `.mcp/servers.json` + `.harness/claims.json` via `harness mcp-scan <path>`. Reads only; no dispatch. Use when you are about to expose a new MCP server config to humans/agents. Eyeballing the JSON is wrong because the scan catches policy regressions (capability grants, audit gaps) that humans miss. [Return shape: {success, data, degraded, exitCode}. success===true iff exitCode===0 (includes graceful-degradation path where dep is absent — check degraded for that). success===false with exitCode===1 = intentional alert exit (read data.alert.triggered). success===false with exitCode===2 = input error (data is null).]
name: metaharness_mcp_scan
